capabilities.description: Apollo module Activity Trace. Return recent action-bus tasks and event-bus events.
Apollo module Activity Trace. Return recent failed Apollo actions.
Apollo module Activity Trace. Export recent operational activity to Workspace.
Apollo module Automation Engine. Create a one-shot or interval automation that calls an Apollo capability later.
Apollo module Automation Engine. List saved automations.
Apollo module Automation Engine. Remove an automation by id.
Apollo module Automation Engine. Run due automations through Apollo's normal permission/action bus.
Apollo module Background Intelligence. Run read-mostly Apollo maintenance/health pulse.
Apollo module Background Intelligence. Read latest maintenance snapshot.
Apollo module Apollo Benchmark Suite. Run Apollo infrastructure regression checks without invoking an LLM.
Apollo module Apollo Benchmark Suite. Read most recent benchmark report.
Apollo module Calculator. Calculate a mathematical arithmetic expression accurately.
Apollo module Capability Graph. Return capability nodes grouped by provider.
Apollo module Capability Graph. Rank capabilities that could form a workflow for a task.
Apollo module Chat Memory Module. Save a useful user/assistant exchange into Apollo's persistent local chat memory.
Apollo module Chat Memory Module. Search Apollo's stored conversation memories for exchanges relevant to a query.
Apollo module Chat Memory Module. Return Apollo's most recent persistent chat memories.
Apollo module Chat Memory Module. Return a compact persistent conversation context containing recent exchanges in chronological order plus older exchanges relevant to the current query.
Apollo module Chat Memory Module. Return the most recent meaningful user request from persistent conversation memory, skipping retry phrases and trivial acknowledgements.
Apollo module Chat Memory Module. Return statistics for Apollo's persistent chat memory.
Apollo module Apollo Cluster Manager. List online Apollo worker nodes and capabilities.
Apollo module Apollo Cluster Manager. Plan assignments for explicit task envelopes without running them.
Apollo module Apollo Cluster Manager. Run an explicit list of allow-listed worker tasks in parallel across capable Apollo nodes.
Apollo module Apollo Cluster Manager. Send independent prompt subtasks to available Ollama worker nodes in parallel and aggregate results.
Apollo module Context Manager. Build a compact internal coordination packet for a task.
Apollo module Context Manager. Return Context Manager health/last task.
Apollo module Conversation Flow. Build a compact conversation-continuity packet from the current message and recent visible chat history.
Apollo module Conversation Flow. Describe Conversation Flow rules and readiness.
Apollo module Core Services. List Apollo capabilities, risk levels and permission decisions.
Apollo module Core Services. Return Apollo runtime/module health.
Apollo module Core Services. Read recent internal event-bus messages.
Apollo module Core Services. Read shared Apollo blackboard state.
Apollo module Core Services. Write shared Apollo blackboard state.
Apollo module Core Services. Create a recovery ZIP of Apollo core and modules.
Apollo module Core Services. Change one capability permission.
Apollo module Core Services. Apply Safe, Normal or Developer permission profile.
Apollo module Core Services. List installed-module failure/quarantine records.
Apollo module Core Services. Clear a module quarantine so Apollo can retry it.
Apollo module Core Services. Compact Apollo health/goals/actions/shared-state summary.
Apollo module Dependency Manager. Check a package/import in Apollo main environment.
Apollo module Dependency Manager. List installed Python distributions.
Apollo module Dependency Manager. Return exact pip command without running it.
Apollo module Dependency Manager. Install package into Apollo main environment; high-risk permission gated.
Apollo module Dependency Manager. Create dedicated virtual environment under storage/environments/venvs.
Apollo module Dependency Manager. List Apollo virtual environments.
Apollo module Dependency Manager. Install package into named isolated environment.
Apollo module Desktop Services. Read current OS text clipboard.
Apollo module Desktop Services. Set OS text clipboard.
Apollo module Desktop Services. Open an Apollo-managed path with the operating-system default application.
Apollo module Desktop Services. Inspect the Windows file association for an extension such as .py or .txt.
Apollo module Apollo Device Agent. Return this Apollo node identity/capabilities and worker-agent status.
Apollo module Apollo Device Agent. Start the authenticated Fleet/Cluster worker service.
Apollo module Apollo Device Agent. Stop the local Fleet/Cluster worker service.
Apollo module Apollo Device Agent. Configure node name, role, group, host, port and auto-start.
Apollo module Apollo Device Agent. Return this node's enrollment token for adding it to a trusted Fleet Authority.
Apollo module Apollo Device Agent. Rotate this node's Fleet authentication token.
Apollo module Device Bridge. List available serial/USB devices for Arduino, OBD and sensor modules.
Apollo module Device Bridge. Read lines from a serial port for a bounded time.
Apollo module Device Bridge. Write text to a serial device. Hardware-changing action is permission-gated.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. Return Apollo's persistent active Workspace project. This survives restarts.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. List real project folders currently under Apollo/workspace.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. Set the persistent active Workspace project by existing project name.

Apollo module Apollo File Builder. Create or replace a complete multi-file coding project in ONE call. Use this for ordinary apps, scripts, websites and projects whose files must work together. Every supplied code block must become a real file. Apollo performs static syntax/local-link verification after writing. Do NOT use for Apollo extension modules; use module_factory.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. Create or replace one real text/code file inside Apollo/workspace.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. Statically verify an existing workspace project without executing it. Checks Python syntax, relative/local Python imports and common local web-file references.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. Return the real project tree and Apollo project metadata.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. Create a folder inside Apollo's workspace.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. List real files currently in Apollo's workspace.
Apollo module Apollo File Builder. Read a text/code file from Apollo's workspace.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. List Apollo file-manager roots and real OS paths.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. List a real directory directly from disk.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Read a text/code file.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Write a text file; Apollo root is protected.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Move a real file/folder between Apollo roots; Windows changes immediately.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Copy a real file/folder between Apollo roots without changing the source.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Copy explicitly supplied Windows/OS files or folders into an Apollo-managed location.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Rename a real file/folder in place.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Create a real folder.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Move a real item into recoverable Apollo trash.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. List recoverable Apollo trash.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Restore a trash entry to its original path.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Find files by partial name across Apollo roots.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Detect likely misplaced projects/modules/code without moving anything.
Apollo module Apollo File Manager. Reveal a real Apollo file/folder in Windows Explorer.
Apollo module Apollo Fleet Manager. List enrolled Apollo devices and their last known status.
Apollo module Apollo Fleet Manager. Enroll a trusted Apollo Device Agent using its URL and enrollment token.
Apollo module Apollo Fleet Manager. Refresh status for all enrolled devices.
Apollo module Apollo Fleet Manager. Rename/regroup/change logical role of an enrolled device.
Apollo module Apollo Fleet Manager. Revoke a device from Fleet/Cluster use.
Apollo module Apollo Fleet Manager. Remove a device record from the local Fleet registry.
Apollo module GPU Monitor. Read NVIDIA GPU name, utilization, VRAM, temperature and power using nvidia-smi.
Apollo module GPU Monitor. List NVIDIA compute processes and their reported GPU memory usage.
Apollo module Knowledge Graph. Add/update a source-linked relation in Apollo Knowledge Graph.
Apollo module Knowledge Graph. Return graph edges touching a concept.
Apollo module Knowledge Graph. Search graph subjects, relations and objects.
Apollo module Knowledge Graph. Return graph size.
Apollo module Memory Bank. Store useful information in Apollo's named Memory Bank.
Apollo module Memory Bank. Search Apollo's named Memory Bank.
Apollo module Memory Bank. List recent named memories.
Apollo module Memory Bank. Remove a Memory Bank entry by id or exact name.
Apollo module Memory Bank. Return Memory Bank statistics.
Apollo module Memory Distillation. Remove command-wrapper junk and create a canonical display topic/fingerprint.
Apollo module Memory Distillation. Turn accepted Pile passages into compact memory key points plus provenance.
Apollo module Memory Intelligence. Inspect Memory Bank size/types/source distribution without modifying it.
Apollo module Memory Intelligence. Find same-name Memory Bank entries that may conflict or duplicate.
Apollo module Memory Intelligence. Report learned/updated dates for oldest/newest named memories.
Apollo module Model Runtime. List Ollama models installed on configured local server.
Apollo module Model Runtime. Return current fallback model and specialist role profiles.
Apollo module Model Runtime. Persist fallback/general Ollama model.
Apollo module Model Runtime. Assign a model to a specialist role.
Apollo module Model Runtime. Assign model, temperature and context size to a role.
Apollo module Model Runtime. Deterministically choose a role/profile for a task without asking another LLM.
Apollo module Apollo Module Factory. Read Apollo's official module manifest/module templates and rules. Use this BEFORE creating or repairing an Apollo module.
Apollo module Apollo Module Factory. Read the current files of an existing pending Apollo module so you can diagnose and repair it.

Apollo module Apollo Module Factory. Create a NEW Apollo module candidate in pending_modules. This does NOT install or enable the module. The candidate must pass validation/tests and then be explicitly approved by the user.

Apollo module Apollo Module Factory. Modify a file in an existing PENDING module to repair it. Allowed files: module.py, manifest.json, tests.py, README.md. The module remains pending until validation and user approval.
Apollo module Neural Learning Module. Teach Apollo's auxiliary neural classifier a labelled text example. Use several different examples for every label before training.

Apollo module Neural Learning Module. Train and validate Apollo's small neural classifier. Training uses multiple restarts and a held-out validation set; a model is only marked ready_for_use when it clears the quality gate.
Apollo module Neural Learning Module. Predict learned labels for text using the trained network.
Apollo module Neural Learning Module. Show dataset quality, training progress and model evaluation.
Apollo module Neural Learning Module. List recent labelled examples.
Apollo module Neural Visualizer. Return a summary of the neural_learning model available for visualization.

Apollo module Neural Visualizer. Run text through Apollo's trained neural network and return input features, hidden activations, output probabilities and strongest learned connections for visualization.
Apollo module Notification Center. Create a persistent Apollo notification.
Apollo module Notification Center. List recent Apollo notifications.
Apollo module Notification Center. Mark a notification read.
Apollo module Orchestrator. Add a persistent Apollo goal for cross-model/subsystem coordination.
Apollo module Orchestrator. List persistent Apollo goals.
Apollo module Orchestrator. Update persistent goal status/notes.
Apollo module Orchestrator. Create a compact shared context packet for another Apollo model/subsystem.
Apollo module Orchestrator. Put a named value on Apollo's persistent shared blackboard.
Apollo module The Pile Knowledge. Search Apollo's persistent locally compiled knowledge.
Apollo module The Pile Knowledge. Search The Pile. Apollo tries Hugging Face online first and falls back to any locally cached Pile Parquet shards.

Apollo module The Pile Knowledge. Search The Pile, reject unrelated passages and compile relevant passages into Apollo's persistent knowledge. auto_cache can download one Lite shard if every remote request times out.
Apollo module The Pile Knowledge. Show how many local Pile Parquet cache shards Apollo has.
Apollo module The Pile Knowledge. Download/resume local Pile cache shards. One shard is roughly 233-266 MB. shards=1 is the Lite cache.
Apollo module The Pile Knowledge. Import Apollo's saved Research & Training files into compiled knowledge.
Apollo module The Pile Knowledge. Add trusted text directly into Apollo's compiled knowledge.
Apollo module The Pile Knowledge. Return statistics for Apollo's compiled knowledge database.
Apollo module Process Manager. List running local processes with PID/CPU/memory.
Apollo module Process Manager. Read one process by PID.
Apollo module Process Manager. Terminate a process by PID. High-risk and blocked by default.
Apollo module Apollo Roadmap. Return Apollo's internal development roadmap.
Apollo module Apollo Roadmap. Update the status or summary of one roadmap milestone.
Apollo module Apollo Roadmap. List machine-readable placeholders for planned Apollo features.
Apollo module Apollo Roadmap. Read one planned feature blueprint.
Apollo module Screen Vision. Report available Qt screens without capturing pixels.
Apollo module Screen Vision. Capture the primary screen to Apollo storage. Privacy-sensitive and permission-gated.
Apollo module Apollo Self Awareness. Inspect Apollo's own project structure, including source files and installed module folders. Read-only.
Apollo module Apollo Self Awareness. List Apollo source/config files. Use this before reading a file when you need to understand Apollo's own implementation.
Apollo module Apollo Self Awareness. Read a text source/config file from Apollo's own project. This tool is deliberately read-only.
Apollo module Apollo Self Awareness. Search Apollo's source code for a word or phrase and return matching file names and line numbers.
Apollo module Self-Improvement Lab. Read-only audit of Apollo source/TODO/FIXME.
Apollo module Self-Improvement Lab. Create approval-gated improvement proposal; does not alter core.
Apollo module Self-Improvement Lab. Write coordinated multi-file candidate under Workspace/self_improvement; never auto-applied.
Apollo module Self-Improvement Lab. Static-check staged Python and list hashes; does not execute/apply.
Apollo module Self-Improvement Lab. List staged proposals.
Apollo module Self-Improvement Lab. Create recovery snapshot before user-approved change.
Apollo module System Information. Read current CPU, RAM, disk and operating-system status from this computer.
Apollo module Task & Goal Engine. Create a persistent multi-step plan; does not execute steps automatically.
Apollo module Task & Goal Engine. List persistent plans.
Apollo module Task & Goal Engine. Return a plan and its steps.
Apollo module Task & Goal Engine. Update one step after real work and attach evidence/capability.
Apollo module Task & Goal Engine. Return pending/blocked/failed steps from active plans.
Apollo module Task & Goal Engine. Complete only when all steps are done/skipped.
Apollo module Terminal Bridge. Run a shell command inside Apollo workspace. High-risk and blocked by default.
Apollo module Terminal Bridge. Return Apollo terminal workspace root.

Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Speak Apollo text aloud asynchronously using the saved Voice Studio profile. Optional arguments can temporarily override voice, gender, accent, emotion, depth, pitch, rate or volume.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Immediately stop the speech process started by Apollo.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Render text to a local WAV using the saved or temporarily overridden Voice Studio profile.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. List installed Windows text-to-speech voice names.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. List installed Windows voices with gender, age and culture metadata.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Get Apollo's saved Voice Studio profile.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Persist Apollo's default voice modulation profile for future replies.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Reset Voice Studio to the neutral defaults.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Preview text using a temporary voice profile without changing the saved profile.

Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Record one microphone utterance, transcribe it offline with Windows speech recognition, and when Voice Studio saving is enabled keep the WAV + transcript as future TinyVoice training data.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Return saved dictation recording count, approved count and total recorded seconds.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. List saved voice-training samples and transcripts.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Mark a saved voice sample good/bad and approve/unapprove it for future voice training.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Delete one saved dictation WAV and its manifest record.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. Listen to the default microphone once and return offline Windows speech-recognition text. Intended for Apollo's Dictate button.
Apollo module Speech I/O + Voice Studio. List installed Windows offline speech recognizers.
Apollo module To-Do List. Add a persistent item to Apollo's To-Do List.
Apollo module To-Do List. Remove a To-Do List item by id or title.
Apollo module To-Do List. Edit a To-Do List item.
Apollo module To-Do List. Tick off a To-Do List item after its work actually succeeds.
Apollo module To-Do List. Reopen a completed To-Do List item.
Apollo module To-Do List. List Apollo's To-Do List items.
Apollo module To-Do List. Return open To-Do List items as an execution plan. Perform real actions, then complete each successful item.
Apollo module Training Module. Search the public web for research sources and return titles, URLs and snippets.
Apollo module Training Module. Fetch readable text from a public HTTP/HTTPS webpage.
Apollo module Training Module. Save research text into Apollo's protected local training-module storage.
Apollo module Training Module. Read a saved research note from Apollo's training-module storage.
Apollo module Training Module. List locally saved research/training files.
Apollo module Training Module. Search Apollo's locally saved research files and return relevant snippets. Use this before re-researching a topic Apollo may already know.
Apollo module Training Module. Perform real research: search the web, fetch readable text from several source pages, then save the source-backed research locally.
Apollo module Apollo Update Manager. Return this Apollo device update configuration/status.
Apollo module Apollo Update Manager. Configure Apollo update server/channel/device name.
Apollo module Apollo Update Manager. Check the configured signed Apollo release channel.
Apollo module Apollo Update Manager. Download, verify and stage the latest signed Apollo update.
Apollo module Apollo Update Manager. Trust an Apollo release public key PEM file.
Apollo module Apollo Update Manager. Launch the external updater for a staged signed release. Apollo must close for core files to restart cleanly.
Apollo module Upgrade History. Append an Apollo release/change record.
Apollo module Upgrade History. List recorded Apollo changes.
Apollo module Upgrade History. Create recovery snapshot and core hashes.
Apollo module Upgrade History. Hash important Apollo core files.
Apollo module Verification Engine. Verify Python syntax and Apollo project metadata for a Workspace project.
Apollo module Verification Engine. Run Apollo real pending-module validator.
Apollo module Verification Engine. Inspect action-bus execution evidence.
Apollo module Voice Agent. Read hands-free voice/wake-word settings.
Apollo module Voice Agent. Set wake word and hands-free voice settings.
Apollo module Voice Agent. Start a background wake-word monitor using Speech I/O. Microphone access is permission-gated.
Apollo module Voice Agent. Stop the background wake-word monitor.
Apollo module Voice Center. Return the status of Apollo's unified voice modules.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Check ffmpeg, optional transcription and local neural TTS backend readiness.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Return isolated XTTS worker process status without importing the model in Apollo's GUI process.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Stop the isolated XTTS worker and free its CPU/GPU memory. It will restart on the next neural speech request.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Import and analyse a local single-speaker voice source for Apollo's personal-use Voice Imprint workflow.

Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. One-click personal-use workflow: import a local audio file, analyse/split it, train Apollo's acoustic voice signature, create an XTTS-ready reference pack, and optionally activate the finished profile.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Report separately whether the selected voice profile is ready and whether the shared XTTS base speech engine is ready.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Launch Apollo's local XTTS v2 installer/repair utility in a separate console. The user must explicitly accept the XTTS model terms in that installer.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Search Apollo and common local Coqui TTS cache folders for an already-installed XTTS model containing config.json and model.pth.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Play the extracted reference WAV for a prepared Voice Imprint profile.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. List imported voice profiles and training status.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Return one profile's dataset, quality, signature and backend status.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Train Apollo's small local acoustic autoencoder on the imported clips and save a compact voice/style embedding.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Return live Voice Imprint training state, progress, current epoch and loss.

Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Optionally transcribe prepared clips with faster-whisper if it is already installed/local. Useful for future fine-tuning datasets; not required for reference-conditioned XTTS synthesis.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Configure a local XTTS model directory and language. Apollo never downloads a voice model automatically.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Get the selected/active Voice Imprint profile's saved XTTS and audio tuning controls.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Save speed, depth/pitch, expressiveness, sampling and EQ controls for a Voice Imprint profile.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Reset one Voice Imprint profile to natural tuning defaults.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Activate a trained/imported profile as Apollo's preferred neural voice.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Disable Voice Imprint routing and return Apollo to the normal Voice Studio engine.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Render text to WAV with the active/profile voice using the configured local neural backend.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Synthesize then play text using the active Voice Imprint profile.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Stop Voice Imprint playback.
Apollo module Voice Imprint Lab. Export the prepared clips/transcripts manifest path for future TinyVoice/fine-tuning work.
Apollo module Web Explorer. Search the public web using DuckDuckGo and return result titles, URLs and snippets. Use this for current/public information.
Apollo module Web Explorer. Fetch a public HTTP/HTTPS webpage and extract readable text, title and final URL. Does not execute JavaScript.
Apollo module Workspace Manager. List folders/projects in Apollo workspace.
Apollo module Workspace Manager. List files within a workspace project/path.
Apollo module Workspace Manager. Read a UTF-8 workspace file.
Apollo module Workspace Manager. Write one UTF-8 workspace file. Use file_builder for whole multi-file builds.
Apollo module Workspace Manager. Search text across workspace files.
Apollo module Workspace Manager. Run a Python entry file inside workspace. High-risk execution is permission-gated.
